rule_name: ChangeGuard Confirmatory Decision Rule (P1, P2, P3)

aggregation_definitions.fold_event_macro_f1: Unweighted arithmetic mean of event-level F1 scores across the 9 evaluated events within a fold for a given seed.
aggregation_definitions.seed_mean_event_macro_f1: Arithmetic mean of fold_event_macro_f1 across the 3 seeds (s=0, 1, 2) within a fold.
aggregation_definitions.grand_mean_event_macro_f1: Arithmetic mean of seed_mean_event_macro_f1 across the two confirmatory folds (Fold A and Fold B), effectively weighting each of the 18 unique confirmatory events equally.
aggregation_definitions.across_seed_sample_sd: Standard deviation across the 3 seed macro F1 values within a fold, using denominator (N - 1) = 2.
aggregation_definitions.tail_events_pool: The lowest 1 event (worst-event) or lowest 3 events (bottom-3 mean) evaluated within each fold or pooled across the 18 confirmatory events.
aggregation_definitions.driven_by_one_event_definition: A gain is considered 'driven by only one event' if subtracting the single largest positive per-event delta (R2 - R0) reduces the grand mean event-macro delta to below 0.000.
aggregation_definitions.precision_recall_collapse_definition: Widespread collapse is defined as either: 1. A decrease in event-macro precision of >= 0.050 relative to R0; or 2. A decrease in event-macro recall of >= 0.050 relative to R0; or 3. More than 4 out of 18 confirmatory events suffering simultaneous precision and recall drops >= 0.030.

P1_average_improvement.name: Criterion P1: Average Improvement
required_conditions: gain_is_not_driven_by_one_event (excluding max single-event gain keeps delta > 0.0)

P2_reliability_improvement.name: Criterion P2: Tail Reliability Improvement
required_conditions: grand_mean_event_macro_f1 delta >= -0.005 (no unacceptable degradation of average performance)

P3_seed_stability.name: Criterion P3: Seed Stability
required_conditions: across_seed_sd_reduction >= 0.20 (20% relative standard deviation reduction: (SD_R0 - SD_R2) / SD_R0 >= 0.20)
stability_direction_present_in_both_folds (SD_R2 < SD_R0 in Fold A AND in Fold B)

inconclusive_outcome.name: Criterion P0: Inconclusive / Unsupported
inconclusive_outcome.condition: Neither P1, P2, nor P3 is satisfied by Recipe R2 on confirmatory folds A and B.

immutability_guarantee: This decision rule is permanently frozen before inspecting any confirmatory evaluation results on Groups A or B. No threshold or definition may be altered post-evaluation.
